title: Short polling vs long polling

kcs.statement: With short polling every T seconds, an update waits T/2 on average to be seen and the server receives clients/T requests per second, most of which return nothing.

With long polling the server holds each request open until data arrives or a timeout fires and the client immediately reissues it, cutting empty responses and delay at the cost of one held connection per waiting client.
